en: "No it doesn't. I promise you it doesn't at all."
ko: "아닙니다. 전혀 상관없다고 장담합니다."

raw: Having supposed that there was sense where there is no sense, and a laudable ambition where there is not a laudable ambition, I am well out of my mistake, and no harm is done.
en: Having assumed there was good sense and healthy ambition where there is none, I am glad to be corrected. No harm is done.
ko: 아무것도 없는 곳에 좋은 분별력과 건강한 야망이 있다고 착각했으니, 잘못을 바로잡게 되어 기쁩니다. 피해를 입은 것은 없습니다.

raw: Young women have committed similar follies often before, and have repented them in poverty and obscurity often before.
en: Young women have made similar foolish decisions before and regretted them in poverty.
ko: 젊은 여성들은 전에도 비슷한 어리석은 결정을 내리고 가난 속에서 후회한 적이 있습니다.

raw: In an unselfish aspect, I am sorry that the thing is dropped, because it would have been a bad thing for me in a worldly point of view; in a selfish aspect, I am glad that the thing has dropped, because it would have been a bad thing for me in a worldly point of view--it is hardly necessary to say I could have gained nothing by it.
en: On one hand, I am sorry it is over, because it would have been a good thing for them; on the other hand, I am glad, because it would have been a burden to me. I would have gained nothing from it.
ko: 한편으로는 그들에게 좋은 일이 되었을 것이기 때문에 끝난 것이 유감스럽지만; 다른 한편으로는 그것이 제게 짐이 되었을 것이기에 기쁩니다. 저는 거기서 아무것도 얻지 못했을 것입니다.

raw: There is no harm at all done.
en: No harm is done.
ko: 피해를 입은 것은 없습니다.

raw: I have not proposed to the young lady, and, between ourselves, I am by no means certain, on reflection, that I ever should have committed myself to that extent.
en: I haven't proposed to the young lady yet, and honestly, after thinking it over, I'm not entirely sure I ever would have gone through with it anyway.
ko: 아직 그 젊은 아가씨에게 청혼하지도 않았고, 솔직히 말해서 곰곰이 생각해보니, 어쨌든 청혼을 끝까지 밀어붙였을지 전혀 확신이 서지 않습니다.

raw: Mr.
en: Mr.
ko: 미스터

raw: Lorry, you cannot control the mincing vanities and giddinesses of empty-headed girls; you must not expect to do it, or you will always be disappointed.
en: Lorry, you cannot control the vanity and silliness of empty-headed girls; you must expect to be disappointed.
ko: 로리, 골이 빈 소녀들의 허영심과 어리석음은 당신이 통제할 수 없습니다; 실망할 각오를 하셔야 합니다.

raw: Now, pray say no more about it.
en: Let's say no more.
ko: 더 이상 말하지 맙시다.

raw: I tell you, I regret it on account of others, but I am satisfied on my own account.
en: I regret it for their sake, but I am satisfied for my own.
ko: 그들을 생각하면 유감이지만, 저 자신을 위해서는 만족합니다.

raw: And I am really very much obliged to you for allowing me to sound you, and for giving me your advice; you know the young lady better than I do; you were right, it never would have done.”
en: Thank you for giving me your advice; you know the young lady better than I do. You were right, it never would have worked."
ko: 조언을 주셔서 감사합니다; 당신이 저보다 그 젊은 아가씨를 더 잘 아시니까요. 당신이 옳았습니다, 그것은 결코 성사되지 않았을 겁니다."

raw: Mr.
en: Mr.
ko: 미스터

raw: Lorry was so taken aback, that he looked quite stupidly at Mr.
en: Lorry was so surprised that he stared at Stryver in disbelief as the lawyer politely pushed him toward the door, acting as if he were showing great generosity and goodwill toward him.
ko: 로리는 너무 놀라서, 변호사가 마치 자신에게 대단한 관대함과 호의를 베푸는 것처럼 행동하며 예의 바르게 그를 문 쪽으로 밀어낼 때 불신에 찬 눈으로 스트라이버를 쳐다보았다.

raw: Stryver shouldering him towards the door, with an appearance of showering generosity, forbearance, and goodwill, on his erring head. “Make the best of it, my dear sir,” said Stryver; “say no more about it; thank you again for allowing me to sound you; good night!”
en: Stryver started pushing him toward the door, acting like he was pouring generosity, patience, and goodwill over his friend's confused head. "Don't feel bad about it, my dear sir," Stryver said. "Say no more. Thank you again for letting me bounce my ideas off of you. Good night!"
ko: 스트라이버는 혼란스러워하는 친구의 머리 위로 관대함과 인내심, 호의를 쏟아붓는 것처럼 행동하며 그를 문 쪽으로 밀기 시작했다. "이 일로 너무 마음 상해하지 마십시오, 친애하는 선생님," 스트라이버가 말했다. "더 이상 말하지 마십시오. 제 생각을 당신과 나눌 수 있게 해주셔서 다시 한번 감사드립니다. 안녕히 가십시오!"

en: Mr.
ko: 미스터

raw: Lorry was out in the night, before he knew where he was.
en: Lorry found himself out in the street before he realized what had happened.
ko: 로리는 무슨 일이 일어났는지 깨닫기도 전에 자신이 거리에 나와 있다는 것을 알게 되었다.

en: Mr.
ko: 미스터

raw: Stryver was lying back on his sofa, winking at his ceiling.
en: Stryver lay back on his sofa, winking at the ceiling.
ko: 스트라이버는 소파에 등을 기대고 누워 천장을 향해 윙크를 했다.
